statement: The consolidated data-owned authoritative-observation watermark (distinct per-table observation time and cause, gateway-minted complete-table receipts, fail-closed publication) together with causally-explained divergence tolerance lands as one bounded committed source change: reconcileAuthoritativeCacheRows skips and excuses only rows the cache's own causal order proves newer than the authoritative read, so the continuously heartbeat-mutated nodes table publishes complete-table observation evidence under live churn while silently dropped writes, genuinely stale caches, and incomplete reads remain fail-closed; the deterministic dt6 composition proves red-on-revert, the TLA model's ExactEqualityReconcileGate mutant violates eventual schema admission while the fixed spec converges, and the unchanged five-node MovieLens live scenario no longer blocks schema admission in the authoritative-observation seam.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Do not relabel an authoritative observation as a CDC mutation, advance schema/version watermarks without source evidence, accept failed or partial reads as fresh, weaken tombstone/causal ordering, or allow an unconfirmed empty read to authorize deletion or freshness. Preserve existing cache mutation timestamps and cause IDs. The causal-supersession excusal must consume the cache's own isStaleForExistingRecord order and never introduce an independent freshness inference.

Do not change the MovieLens 180000ms schema budget, 60000ms stability window, workload, joins, preload size, ratings-only split policy, report conversion, retry duration, operation deadlines, concurrency budgets, or live scenario semantics.

This quest records exactly one consolidated source attempt covering the watermark and churn-tolerance surface (src/admin, src/cache, src/control-plane, test/convergence dt6, models/authoritative-observation-watermark, models/CL-INDEX.md, scripts/model-tlc.js) within the scope-pressure bounds; the admin websocket mock receipt-contract fixture updates are a separate bounded follow-up and must not be folded in.

The consolidated attempt may checkpoint only with its red-on-revert artifact, all three TLC gates met, an independent subagent verifier approval bound to the exact attempt fingerprint, and a live report on the consolidated tree whose schema-admission reasons contain no authoritative_observation or cache_stale_watermark codes.
